I couldn't add the `--type` option: all four edits were blocked because write permission to `src/commands/drain/` hasn't been granted. No files have changed.

This is what I was going to do:

- **`drain.options.js`:** add a `drainTypeFilterOption` named `type`. It would accept the same CLI codes the `create` subcommands use (`syslog-tcp`, `datadog`, `raw-http` and so on, taken from `DRAIN_TYPES`). Each code would be mapped to its API code, and the option would be optional.
- **`drain.command.js`:** register it as `type`. After `getDrains`, the handler would keep only the drains whose `recipient.type` matches. It would apply to both the human and `--format json` output.

After that I'd run `npm run docs`, then `npm run fix-all` and `npm run validate`. I'd also check `drain.docs.md` and `docs/*.md` for any text that needs updating.

If you grant write access, I'll carry on with that. If you'd rather make the edits yourself, the plan above has everything needed.
